snapshot.title: Haptic feedback via navigator.vibrate on key actions
snapshot.description: Add shell-side haptic feedback (navigator.vibrate) triggered by postMessage events: mine hit, rocket land, reward collected. Low-effort mobile feel improvement.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Mine hit event triggers a short vibration pattern
Rocket land / mission complete triggers a distinct vibration pattern
Vibrate calls are no-op on desktop (API absent)
